clips.title: The story
paras: You learn how rest and preparation help you survive beyond city walls. Travelers across Azeroth teach new wanderers to rest by a campfire and prepare for the wilds.

Even a sharp blade or potent magic cannot protect you from the wilds if you neglect the basics of survival. Seasoned wanderers near roadside clearings share this lesson with travelers leaving their home valleys. Resting by a campfire eases sore boots, settles the mind, and readies you for the road ahead. Regular rest and preparation give you a better chance of surviving long enough to find fortune and glory.

Once you understand the value of a fire and proper rest, your instructors point you toward town tradesfolk. A field camp needs more than an ember and a bedroll; survival also calls for practical crafts. You can forge replacement rivets, cook trail rations, or stitch torn gear under the stars. Each profession offers camp fixtures that can help turn a bare hillside into a self-sufficient outpost.

paras: Well howdy there, adventurer. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
